body: The pair is streaked with clouded residue from the treated rows. It was set aside after the flies vanished from the barn and the cattle began to cough.
title: The jar with its clouded rim

body: The kit is unopened. The water bottle has a black line drawn halfway down it and the same line repeated on the charred wall. A stencilled cordon number is on the kit lid. Whoever marked it was measuring what survived the fire, not treating a burn.
title: A waterline after the fire
